description: This source file defines HTTP handlers for DID (Decentralized Identifier) operations and related VC (Verifiable Credential) processing using the Gin web framework. It includes endpoints for DID registration, resolution, VC verification, workflow VC management, and DID document retrieval, primarily serving API requests for an agent platform.

classes.name: DIDHandlers
classes.description: Struct encapsulating DID and VC services to handle HTTP requests related to DID operations, VC verification, and workflow VC management.

methods.name: NewDIDHandlers
methods.description: Constructor function to instantiate DIDHandlers with required DID and VC services.

methods.name: RegisterRoutes
methods.description: Registers all DID-related HTTP routes with the provided Gin router group.

methods.name: RegisterAgent
methods.description: Handles agent DID registration POST requests; validates input and calls DID service.

methods.name: ResolveDID
methods.description: Resolves a DID string to its DID identity information.

methods.name: VerifyVC
methods.description: Verifies a Verifiable Credential provided in the request body.

methods.name: GetWorkflowVCChain
methods.description: Retrieves the VC chain associated with a specific workflow ID.

methods.name: CreateWorkflowVC
methods.description: Creates a new workflow VC with specified execution VC IDs and session info.

methods.name: GetDIDStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the DID system.

methods.name: CreateExecutionVC
methods.description: Creates an execution VC based on provided execution context and related data.

methods.name: ExportVCs
methods.description: Exports VCs filtered by provided query parameters; includes execution and workflow VCs with agent DID list.

methods.name: GetDIDDocument
methods.description: Generates a W3C DID Document representation for a given DID with verification methods and services.
